browsing.tools.attach: Attach files to selected upload field
browsing.tools.click: Click an item on the page
browsing.links.gone: Browse is closed on the device that sent the message (the app quit or went offline)
browsing.links.dropped: Browse closed on the device that sent the message (the app quit or went offline), so this wasn't done
browsing.links.timeout: The device didn't respond within {seconds} s (poor connection, or the app was suspended in the background)
browsing.pick.busy: Still attaching what was picked on this card. Please wait.
browsing.pick.notCandidate: That isn't one of this card's candidates
browsing.pick.onlyOne: This upload field takes only one file. Pick one.
browsing.pick.tooBig: Too large in total (limit {limit}). Pick fewer.
browsing.pick.expired: These candidates expired. Ask again to find them.
browsing.plugin.title: Built-in browser
browsing.plugin.summary: Browse in the HarmonyOS app: the browse sidebar and the floating button on page fields; it reads pages, fills fields, finds and attaches files and clicks buttons for you, and web search can use it
browsing.plugin.purge.cards: Every version of the web page candidates cards (the image-picking cards in chat and the sidebar)
browsing.plugin.purge.thumbnails: The thumbnail cache of candidate files
browsing.plugin.keep.pages: Web pages saved to materials: materials belong to the core; to delete them use bulk delete in Memory · Materials (Settings · Delete materials when the memory plugin is off)
browsing.plugin.keep.secretary: The messages and tool call records of browsing turns in the chat (what you said in the sidebar or on the floating button, the pages it read, its replies)
browsing.plugin.keep.backup: The copy in backup snapshots (gone as snapshots rotate: about 7 days locally, up to about 5 weeks in the sync folder)
browsing.prompt.flag: True while the built-in browser plugin is running (false when disabled in plugins.disabled or not installed): the paragraphs about the browse sidebar and floating button, finding files for upload fields and page text being external data are wrapped in it
browsing.voice.notRecognized: Couldn't make out what was said: {reason}
browsing.voice.empty: Didn't catch that. Say it again?
browsing.voice.onlyFiller: Only heard the model's own filler phrases (like "please like and subscribe"), so they were discarded. Say it again?
